pr_body:
Adds ability to choose Redis client when both Lettuce and Jedis on classpath.

Fixes gh-22559
pr_title: Allow Jedis to be selected when both Jedis and Lettuce are on the classpath
pr_comment: Thanks @bono007. I've polished things up in https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/commit/589669d0cc49f05381cdf947e69804aa4d720a0d. In particular, I've removed the default value for `clientType` as it didn't match the code (the real default is that we configure the client based on the classpath).
@snicoll good catch on the default. Thx.

review_comment: Not super thrilled about this comment - please update if you have a preference.
